items.source: Base class for HandlerMethodArgumentResolver implementations with access to a ReactiveAdapterRegistry and methods to check for method parameter support.
items.translation: 用于 `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver` 实现的基类，可访问ReactiveAdapterRegistry并提供检查方法参数支持的方法。

items.source: An extension of HandlerMethodArgumentResolver for implementations that are synchronous in nature and do not block to resolve values.
items.translation: 用于实现同步且不会阻塞以解析值的 HandlerMethodArgumentResolver 的扩展。

items.source: An extension of AbstractNamedValueArgumentResolver for named value resolvers that are synchronous and yet non-blocking.
items.translation: 用于同步且非阻塞的命名值解析器的 `AbstractNamedValueArgumentResolver` 扩展。

items.source: Uses of HandlerMethodArgumentResolver in org.springframework.web.reactive.result.method
items.translation: `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver` 接口在 `org.springframework.web.reactive.result.method` 包中的用法

items.source: Uses of HandlerMethodArgumentResolver in org.springframework.web.reactive.result.method.annotation
items.translation: `HandlerMethodArgumentResolver` 接口在 `org.springframework.web.reactive.result.method.annotation` 包中的用法

items.source: Resolves ServerWebExchange-related method argument values of the following types: ServerWebExchange ServerHttpRequest ServerHttpResponse HttpMethod Locale TimeZone ZoneId UriBuilder or UriComponentsBuilder -- for building URL's relative to the current request
items.translation: 解决以下类型的与 `ServerWebExchange` 相关的方法参数值： ServerWebExchange ServerHttpRequest ServerHttpResponse HttpMethod Locale TimeZone ZoneId UriBuilder 或 UriComponentsBuilder —— 用于构建相对于当前请求的 URL

items.source: Resolves method arguments of type HttpEntity or RequestEntity by reading the body of the request through a compatible HttpMessageReader.
items.translation: 解析类型为HttpEntity或RequestEntity的方法参数，通过兼容的HttpMessageReader读取请求正文。

items.source: Resolve Errors or BindingResult method arguments.
items.translation: 解析 `Errors` 或 `BindingResult` 方法参数。

items.source: Resolves arguments of type Map annotated with @MatrixVariable where the annotation does not specify a name.
items.translation: 解析带有未指定名称的 `Map` 类型参数的 `@MatrixVariable` 注解。

items.source: Resolver for a controller method argument of type Model that can also be resolved as a Map.
items.translation: 用于解析类型为Model的控制器方法参数，该参数也可以解析为Map。

items.source: Resolver for Map method arguments annotated with @PathVariable where the annotation does not specify a path variable name.
items.translation: 用于解析带有 `Map` 方法参数的注解的解析器，其中该注解未指定路径变量名称。 @PathVariable

items.source: Resolver for Map method arguments annotated with @RequestParam where the annotation does not specify a request parameter name.
items.translation: 用于解析带有 `Map` 方法参数注解的 @RequestParam，且该注解未指定请求参数名称的情况。

items.source: Resolver for a SessionStatus argument obtaining it from the BindingContext.
items.translation: 用于从 BindingContext 获取 SessionStatus 参数的解析器。

items.source: Resolves Map method arguments annotated with @RequestHeader.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@RequestHeader` 注解的 `Map` 方法参数。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with @RequestHeader except for Map arguments.
items.translation: 解析带有 @RequestHeader 注解的方法参数，但 Map 参数除外。

items.source: Abstract base class for argument resolvers that resolve method arguments by reading the request body with an HttpMessageReader.
items.translation: 用于通过读取请求体来解析方法参数的参数解析器的抽象基类，该读取操作使用HttpMessageReader。

items.source: Resolves argument values of type SemanticApiVersionParser.Version.
items.translation: 解析类型为SemanticApiVersionParser.Version的参数值。

items.source: Resolves arguments annotated with @MatrixVariable.
items.translation: 解析带有@MatrixVariable注解的参数。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with @PathVariable.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@PathVariable` 注解的方法参数。

items.source: Resolves method argument value of type Principal.
items.translation: 解析类型为Principal的方法参数值。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with an @RequestAttribute.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@RequestAttribute` 注解的方法参数。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with @RequestBody by reading the body of the request through a compatible HttpMessageReader.
items.translation: 通过兼容的 `HttpMessageReader` 读取请求体，解析带有 `@RequestBody` 注解的方法参数。

items.source: Resolver for method arguments annotated with @RequestParam from URI query string parameters.
items.translation: 用于从 URI 查询字符串参数解析带有@RequestParam注解的方法参数的解析器。

items.source: Resolver for @RequestPart arguments where the named part is decoded much like an @RequestBody argument but based on the content of an individual part instead.
items.translation: 用于解析 `@RequestPart` 参数的解决方案，其中命名部分被解码的方式类似于 `@RequestBody` 参数，但基于单个部分的内容。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with an @SessionAttribute.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@SessionAttribute` 注解的方法参数。

items.source: Resolves method argument value of type WebSession.
items.translation: 解析类型为WebSession的方法参数值。

items.source: Configure the argument resolvers to use for resolving method argument values against a ServerWebExchange.
items.translation: 配置用于针对ServerWebExchange解析方法参数值的参数解析器。

items.source: No-op resolver for method arguments of type Continuation.
items.translation: Continuation 类型方法参数的无操作解析器。

items.source: Resolve method arguments annotated with @CookieValue.
items.translation: 解析带有@CookieValue注解的方法参数。

items.source: Resolves method arguments annotated with @Value.
items.translation: 解析带有@Value注解的方法参数。

items.source: Resolve @ModelAttribute annotated method arguments.
items.translation: 解析带有 `@ModelAttribute` 注解的方法参数。

items.source: Infrastructure for handler method processing.
items.translation: 处理器方法处理的底层架构。

items.source: Infrastructure for annotation-based handler method processing.
items.translation: 基于注解的处理器方法处理的基础设施。

items.source: Return the configured argument resolvers.
items.translation: 返回配置的参数解析器。

items.source: Abstract base class for resolving method arguments from a named value.
items.translation: 用于从命名值解析方法参数的抽象基类。

items.source: Configure resolvers for custom controller method arguments.
items.translation: 为自定义控制器方法参数配置解析器。
